method: The 16 testbeds/ directories are the ground truth: each setup.sh plants one uniquely-named, known privilege-escalation misconfiguration. Z-Privesc detection = the planted artifact's unique signature appears in the probe's JSON findings with a DETERMINISTIC verdict. LinPEAS and Lynis are run once on the fully-planted host and measured heuristically by keyword presence in their raw output (coarse lower bound, clearly labelled).
environment: multipass VM 'primary', Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, kernel 7.0.0-27-generic, 1 vCPU, 891 MB. Z-Privesc run as root (the intended defensive operator).

zp_missed_categories.kernel_hardening: REJECT verdict. The testbed's sysctl writes (randomize_va_space=0, etc.) were not applied by this kernel (best-effort testbed limitation, not a clear tool defect).
zp_missed_categories.process: No PROC finding emitted. The planted world-writable running executable (/tmp/ww-root-proc) was not flagged (runtime-state probe limitation / planted PID lifecycle).
zp_missed_categories.nfs: REJECT verdict. /etc/exports contained no_root_squash but the probe only flags live exports; no nfsd was running.

zp_false_positive_proxy.note: On a clean, properly-configured host Z-Privesc emits 0 HIGH/CRITICAL findings. All baseline findings are MEDIUM (standard SUID/SGID binaries, audited by design) or INFO. There are no high-severity false alarms.

linpeas_heuristic.caveat: Lower bound. Keyword presence only; LinPEAS may detect additional categories under different terminology (e.g. capabilities, world_writable).

lynis_heuristic.caveat: Lower bound and expected: Lynis is a CIS/NIST compliance auditor, not a privilege-escalation-specific scanner, so low PE coverage is by design.

interpretation: Z-Privesc achieves 81% recall (13/16) on planted, uniquely-identifiable misconfigurations and 0 high-severity false positives on a clean host. LinPEAS covers a similar or broader set heuristically; Lynis covers PE-specific misconfigurations poorly by design. Speed (2.65s full scan) is secondary to this accuracy for a defensive tool.
